title: Work split over threads
description:
Add up a large range with several threads.

```
thread 0: sum of 1..=250000 = 31250125000
thread 1: ...
total: 500000500000 (matches the formula: true)
```
hints: For part `i`, the range is `i * n / parts + 1 ..= (i + 1) * n / parts` (lesson 6.01).
requirements: Split 1 to 1,000,000 into four parts and spawn a thread for each with `std::thread::spawn` and `move`.
Collect the `JoinHandle`s and add up their results.
stretch: Use `thread::scope` so the threads can borrow a slice instead of owning their data.
